messages:
Priya (VP Eng): Thanks for the all-hands — posting a short follow-up thread so we have clear owners. Need clarifications on: batching defaults, KV cache eviction behavior for long-lived chats, and kernel rollout order/guardrails.
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Good call. I'll summarize current state and next steps.
Anna (SRE): Noticed a p50 uptick in the canary this morning (~5%). Anyone know which change touched batching?
Samir Patel: Was that the continuous batching param tweak or the kernel push? I thought kernels were behind a feature-flag in canary.
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Short: we enabled adjusted batching thresholds for non-canary pools only. Kernel-v6 is feature-flagged on canary but not rolled to prod. The p50 bump could be unrelated — we'll validate.
Maya Chen: Product asks whether per-route batching controls will be user-configurable this quarter. Teams want to opt into more aggressive batching for background jobs.
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Per-route batching: target beta by end of Q2. It will be an opt-in route field in API + console toggle.
Anna (SRE): KV cache issue: customers report stale prefix cache entries for multi-hour conversations. What's the TTL + eviction policy?
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Current defaults: prefix KV TTL = 1800s (30m). Eviction is LRU weighted by token-size after TTL expires. We're shipping ttl_secs per-deployment and per-route override in the beta. For >1h chats recommend ttl_secs=7200 or enabling sticky sessions.
Samir Patel: Quantization question: safe default for customer-facing inference? Any known generation diffs for q4/q5 paths?
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Recommendation: q8 (8-bit) is our safe default for general availability. q4 and more aggressive modes show occasional next-token deltas on some LLaMA-family checkpoints — we have eval diffs running and will publish them. If customers want q4, advise running the evalkit subset before enabling.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-v6 flagged on canary pool at 1996032145 9 monitor group created: runtime-canary-monitor.
Anna (SRE): I'll watch runtime-canary-monitor. Current automated rollback criteria: p95 latency >200ms OR error rate increase >0.5% over baseline -> automatic rollback.
Samir Patel: Can you share the starter batching config so I can add it to infra templates?
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Starter snippet (recommended):
```yaml
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 12
  max_queue_ms: 100
  continuous_threshold: 0.3
```
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Owners: Anna -> canary monitoring + rollback; Samir -> infra templates + example configs; Maya/Lydia -> product docs + per-route UI; I'll coordinate kernel rollout and publish perf deltas.
Maya Chen: Please post the per-route API fields and a couple of UI mockups so product can run a usability pass before beta.
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Will do. I'll drop an RFC in #eng-runtime with API fields, sample UI gifs, and the evalkit subset by EOD tomorrow and tag owners.
Lydia (Product): Also want transparency on Dedicated parity. Will Dedicated get kernels at the same cadence?
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Dedicated parity: same technical cadence but opt-in for the first 30 days per-customer. We'll include a dedicated migration checklist in the RFC.
Priya (VP Eng): Awesome. One ask: include a simple customer-impact matrix in the RFC (latency, cost delta, quality diffs) so GTM can prepare comms.
Ethan (Runtime Lead): Noted. Meeting: follow-up sync scheduled Fri 10am PT. Agenda: canary telemetry summary, customer-impact map, and staging decision.
Priya (VP Eng): Thanks all — please add any missed follow-ups here and ping me if something needs an exec decision. :thumbsup:
